question: In a triangle \(ABC\), let \(C_1\) be any point on the side \(AB\) other than \(A\) or \(B\). Join \(CC_1\). The line passing through \(A\) and parallel to \(CC_1\) intersects the line \(BC\) extended at \(A_1\). The line passing through \(B\) and parallel to \(CC_1\) intersects the line \(AC\) extended at \(B_1\). The lengths \(AA_1,BB_1,CC_1\) are given to be \(p,q,r\) units respectively. Then

options.D: none of the foregoing statements is true
